QUOTE: Default build (`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` off, `mbedtls_config.h:3787`) … `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` is also off by default (`mbedtls_config.h:2185`)
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are off by default. It never says `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` is off, and the caveat says the default claim was not confirmed from the shipped config. The item probably means the C/PTHREAD pair, and I can't tell that from the answer, so this resolves to MISS.
